accounting.timestamp: PostgreSQL pg_xact_commit_timestamp(xmin), with track_commit_timestamp enabled before orders are written; start at the client's order-confirmation timestamp.
accounting.population: Every successful checkout HTTP response containing a nonempty orderId, including responses after an unsuccessful cart request. Failed scheduled operations remain checkout violations.

limits: Separate sums of configured ceilings, not reservations or consumption.
observer: Read-only analysis; no compositional coordinate enters the controller.
memory_policy: CPU receiver benefit observed in both revised engineering runners. Extra RAM did not show a reversible benefit; memory allocations vary only between initial contexts, not within histories. This series does not test jointly moving CPU and RAM or causal resource interaction.
technical_revision: Handle disappearing diagnostic PIDs without discarding SLO outcomes; preserve Docker events, generator samples and actual overlap. Advertising reserve raised from 384 to 512 MiB after a restart. Warmup extended to 120 s.
